description: cbstats-kvtimings.md's Description ('This command is useful to understand various states of the storage system') and its entire 'Table 1. Couchstore database engine stats' options table are byte-identical to cbstats-kvstore.md - confirmed by direct diff of both pages. But kvtimings' own EXAMPLE section shows real, distinct content that has nothing to do with the copied Couchstore-counters table: a 'Sample histogram' of per-operation latency buckets (e.g. 'rw_3:commit (50457 total)' followed by millisecond-range rows). kvtimings actually returns latency histograms, not the kvstore counters its own Description and Table 1 claim to describe.
